title: 07. Add a password prompt to your command line interface (cli)

examples.input:
from typer.testing import CliRunner
runner = CliRunner()
result = runner.invoke(app, ["--username", "Ada", "--password", "test-password"])
print(result.exit_code)
print(result.output, end="")

test_hidden_password_and_confirmation.title: test_hidden_password_and_confirmation
test_hidden_password_and_confirmation.code:
def test_hidden_password_and_confirmation():
    result = invoke([], input="alice\nprivate-value\nprivate-value\n")
    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
    assert "Username" in result.output and "Password" in result.output
    assert "Repeat for confirmation" in result.output
    assert "Authenticated as alice" in result.output
    assert "private-value" not in result.output

test_mismatch_retries_without_echoing_se.title: test_mismatch_retries_without_echoing_secrets
test_mismatch_retries_without_echoing_se.code:
def test_mismatch_retries_without_echoing_secrets():
    result = invoke(["--username", "bob"], input="wrong-value\nother-value\ncorrect-value\ncorrect-value\n")
    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
    assert "do not match" in result.output
    assert "Authenticated as bob" in result.output
    assert all(secret not in result.output for secret in ["wrong-value", "other-value", "correct-value"])

test_password_option_is_hidden_in_help.code:
def test_password_option_is_hidden_in_help():
    result = invoke(["--help"])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert "--username" in result.output and "--password" in result.output

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your implementation above the supplied tests. Run checks the sample tests. Submit checks all supplied tests. Keep the tests and runner unchanged.

For an older saved solution, use **+** beside the editor tabs to open the current template. Copy your implementation into the new tab. Your old tab stays in place.

These templates and tests are recreations from the public descriptions. Real Typer, Click, and Rich packages are bundled for offline use. Use Run and Submit; the playground and debugger do not load the library archive. Keep script entry points inside `if __name__ == "__main__":`. The runner supports the pytest features used by the supplied tests. Select Python.

[Original Pybites exercise](https://pybitesplatform.com/bites/add-a-password-prompt-to-your-command-line-interface-cli/)
